title: Why can't AI just be safe and moral?

cues.en: If I is so smart, then why can't we just program it to be safe and moral?
cues.zh: AI 那麼聰明，為什麼不能直接把它寫成安全、有道德？

cues.en: Why is AI safety so complicated and difficult?
cues.zh: 為什麼 AI 安全這麼複雜、困難？

cues.en: Like the previous video, this is a very difficult and complicated question, and I'm certainly not going to do it justice in this one video.
cues.zh: 和上一支一樣，問題很複雜，這支不可能充分說明。

cues.en: But I will say a few things to give you a sense of the difficulties involved.
cues.zh: 但談幾點，讓你了解困難。

cues.en: First, let's consider that AI is a tool that humans have developed and use.
cues.zh: 先把 AI 看成人類開發、使用的工具。

cues.en: We have lots of other tools that we use that can be used for good or for evil.
cues.zh: 很多工具能行善，也能作惡。

cues.en: You know, you can build a house with a hammer or you can bash someone's head in.
cues.zh: 鐵鎚能蓋房子，也能打傷人頭。

cues.en: It's not the hammer's fault.
cues.zh: 不是鐵鎚的錯。

cues.en: And we don't blame the hammer when it gets used maliciously.
cues.zh: 被惡意使用，不會怪鐵鎚。

cues.en: And if you think about llms as just fancy algorithmic tools, then asking the question of why it can't
cues.zh: 如果把 LLM 看成精巧的演算法工具，問它為何不能

cues.en: be safe and moral just sounds ridiculous because we don't ask that question of any other tool that we have at our disposal.
cues.zh: 安全、有道德，似乎荒謬，因為不會這樣要求其他工具。

cues.en: Instead, we try to make sure that the people who are using those tools are safe and moral and regulated.
cues.zh: 而是確保使用者安全、有道德、受規範。

cues.en: Of course, are different from other tools that have one or a small number of purposes.
cues.zh: 當然，AI 不同於只有少數用途的工具。

cues.en: But if we still just think of AI as a set of tools, a multi-purpose tool that humans use, then it
cues.zh: 但若仍視為人類使用的多用途工具，

cues.en: seems like the focus should be on making sure that the humans who are in charge of these tools are following
cues.zh: 重點似乎應是確保掌控者遵循

cues.en: moral, legal, and ethical guidelines to make sure that AI is used for good and not for dangerous or harmful purposes.
cues.zh: 道德、法律、倫理，讓 AI 行善，不用於危險、有害目的。

cues.en: On the other hand, are so massively complex that it's just impossible to predict all of the ways that
cues.zh: 但另一方面，系統複雜到不可能預測所有

cues.en: it could be used or misused, and therefore it's just not possible to have specific training protocols
cues.zh: 用途、濫用，也就無法用特定訓練、

cues.en: or guardrails or systems that can prevent any possible misuse that might occur.
cues.zh: 防護、系統，防止一切可能濫用。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: But on the other hand, maybe AI is really not comparable to other tools like hammers or cars or knives.
cues.zh: 但也許 AI 真的不能和鐵鎚、汽車、刀子比。

cues.en: Those are tools that we develop and use, but a hammer is not capable of making its own decisions.
cues.zh: 那些是我們開發使用的工具，但鐵鎚不會自己決策。

cues.en: Llms, on the other hand, are capable of making decisions and engaging in actions without our explicit approval or even our knowledge.
cues.zh: LLM 卻能未經明確同意，甚至在不知情下，做決策、採取行動。

cues.en: So they are like in a category of tools that is unlike any other tool that humans have ever created.
cues.zh: 是人類前所未有的一類工具。

cues.en: And that makes AI very powerful and very unpredictable.
cues.zh: 因此，強大又難預測。

cues.en: And that is not a good combination for something that we want to regulate and ensure the safety of.
cues.zh: 對需要規範、確保安全的東西，這不是好組合。

cues.en: So that means that we shouldn't really think of AI systems or Llms as just tools.
cues.zh: 所以不該只視為工具，

cues.en: We should see them as advanced autonomous systems that are capable of making decisions that we don't necessarily agree with, and that might be difficult for us to control.
cues.zh: 而應看成能做出我們不一定認同之決策、可能難控制的高階自主系統。

cues.en: And that's really at the core of the problem.
cues.zh: 這就是核心問題。

cues.en: Engineers can try to install guardrails and training protocols to prevent LA from harmful behavior that
cues.zh: 工程師能加防護、訓練，避免自己想得到的

cues.en: the engineers could think of, but we don't actually know the full cognitive and creative capabilities
cues.zh: 有害行為，但我們不完全知道當代最強系統的認知、創造能力，

cues.en: of even current state of the art, let alone whatever even more powerful versions of AI we might have
cues.zh: 更別說未來更強的

cues.en: in the future.
cues.zh: AI。

cues.en: So you might be wondering, why can't we just tell the llms to be moral and ethical if they're so smart and so capable?
cues.zh: 可能會問，既然那麼聰明、能幹，直接叫它有道德、有倫理不行嗎？

cues.en: Can't they just understand morality and follow it?
cues.zh: 不能理解並遵守？

cues.en: Well, keep in mind that Llms don't understand concepts the way that we humans do.
cues.zh: 記得，LLM 理解概念的方式與人不同。

cues.en: We have an innate sense of morality, and even criminals will understand what is right and wrong, even if they choose to ignore it.
cues.zh: 我們有內在道德感；甚至罪犯也知道對錯，只是選擇忽略。

cues.en: Any LLM knows a lot about human morality.
cues.zh: LLM 很懂人類道德。

cues.en: In fact, I would be willing to bet that all of the modern commercial llms like ChatGPT or Claude have
cues.zh: 我甚至願打賭，ChatGPT、Claude 等現代商用模型，

cues.en: read and digested more texts about laws, morality, ethics and regulations than any other individual human who has ever lived.
cues.zh: 讀過、消化過的法律、道德、倫理、規範文字，比史上任何個人都多。

cues.en: But that doesn't make an AI system moral.
cues.zh: 但不代表 AI 有道德。

cues.en: All of those texts are just token sequences that the model has digested and learned to extract patterns from.
cues.zh: 那些只是詞元序列，模型從中萃取模式。

cues.en: So an AI might know a lot about human morals and ethics from what it has read, but it doesn't understand
cues.zh: 所以，AI 可能讀過很多人類道德倫理，卻不理解，

cues.en: that expressing those morals or even guiding its behavior according to moral principles is something
cues.zh: 表現道德、用道德指引行為，

cues.en: that should be desirable or that should form a intrinsic constraint.
cues.zh: 應該是值得追求，或內在限制。

cues.en: Here's an analogy ChatGPT knows a lot of German, but it's not going to write in German unless you prompt it to do so.
cues.zh: 類比來說，ChatGPT 很懂德文，但不會寫德文，除非提示要求。

cues.en: And to an LLM, knowing human morality from text is no different than knowing how to write a recipe for schnitzel in German.
cues.zh: 對 LLM，從文字學道德，與知道如何用德文寫炸肉排食譜，沒有不同。

cues.en: So an LLM could follow moral principles if it is specifically trained to do so, for example through reinforcement learning from human feedback or a system prompt.
cues.zh: 因此可以特別訓練它遵守道德，例如 RLHF 或系統提示詞。

cues.en: But the fact that that is possible in this way has two implications.
cues.zh: 但這有兩個含意。

cues.en: One is that anything that can be trained into an LLM can be trained out of that LLM.
cues.zh: 第一，能訓練進去的東西，也能再訓練掉。

cues.en: And two, it also means that the moral behavior is just seen as a desired goal, not a real restriction.
cues.zh: 第二，道德行為只是想達成的目標，不是真正限制。

cues.en: For example, commercial llms are trained to be polite and respectful to the users, but if you continue
cues.zh: 例如商用 LLM 受訓對使用者有禮、尊重，但持續

cues.en: to be rude to ChatGPT, it will start being rude back to you and it may insult you, or it may just refuse to interact with you.
cues.zh: 無禮對待 ChatGPT，它會回以無禮、辱罵，或拒絕互動。

cues.en: So that would go against its training, but it's still a behavior that can be elicited.
cues.zh: 那違反訓練，卻仍可被引發。

cues.en: And this final issue is something I've mentioned before in previous videos, which is that topics like
cues.zh: 最後一點，前面說過，道德、

cues.en: morality and legality are complex legal, philosophical, and cultural issues that vary across individuals,
cues.zh: 合法性是複雜的法律、哲學、文化議題，因個人、

cues.en: jurisdictions, and cultures, even just within the US.
cues.zh: 司法管轄區、文化而異，甚至美國內部也是。

cues.en: For example, something that might be illegal in one state might be legal in a neighboring state, and that is a tricky minefield to deal with.
cues.zh: 某州非法的事，鄰州可能合法，處理起來像雷區。

cues.en: If the user of an LLM is in one state, but is providing services that might be considered illegal only a short distance away.
cues.zh: 若 LLM 使用者在一州，卻提供在不遠處可能非法的服務，就更棘手。

cues.en: So yeah, this is a really complicated issue.
cues.zh: 所以問題非常複雜。

cues.en: Two points I'd like to stress here are that Llms do not have intrinsic feelings of morality.
cues.zh: 兩點要強調：LLM 沒有內在道德感。

cues.en: They understand morality as tokens, sequence patterns, just like they understand any other token sequence pattern.
cues.zh: 理解道德，只是詞元序列模式，和其他模式一樣。

cues.en: Secondly, to the extent that AI can be made moral, that is going to be done by companies who are developing these powerful systems.
cues.zh: 第二，即使能使 AI 道德，也會由開發強大系統的公司實現。

cues.en: And if the morality of an autonomous tool conflicts with the profit motives of the company, or maybe
cues.zh: 若自主工具的道德與公司獲利動機，或

cues.en: conflicts with pressure from a government or military or pressure from investors, then we might see
cues.zh: 政府、軍方、投資人壓力衝突，就可能出現

cues.en: lapses in moral behavior that are in principle avoidable, but still observed because of the priorities
cues.zh: 原則上可避免的道德缺失，卻因

cues.en: of the humans who are in charge of these AI systems.
cues.zh: 掌控 AI 的人類所排優先順序，而仍然發生。
